main.zh: 天是青黑色的，地是黃色的，宇宙在洪荒中形成，廣大而蒙昧。
main.en: Heaven is dark and earth is yellow; the universe began in vast, primal wilderness.
main.simp: 天是青黑色的，地是黄色的，宇宙在洪荒中形成，广大而蒙昧。

main.zh: 太陽有正有斜，月亮有圓有缺，星辰分布排列在天空中。
main.en: The sun climbs and slants, the moon waxes and wanes, and the stars and constellations are ranged across the sky.
main.simp: 太阳有正有斜，月亮有圆有缺，星辰分布排列在天空中。

main.zh: 寒冷來了暑熱就過去，秋天收割，冬天儲藏。
main.en: Cold comes and heat goes; the harvest is gathered in autumn and stored in winter.
main.simp: 寒冷来了暑热就过去，秋天收割，冬天储藏。

main.zh: 積累閏餘的日子成為一年，用六律六呂來調和陰陽。
main.en: Leftover days are added up to make a leap year, and the pitch-pipes are used to harmonise yin and yang.
main.simp: 积累闰余的日子成为一年，用六律六吕来调和阴阳。

main.zh: 雲氣上升就化為雨，露水凝結就成為霜。
main.en: Rising clouds turn into rain, and dew freezing becomes frost.
main.simp: 云气上升就化为雨，露水凝结就成为霜。

main.zh: 金子出產於麗水，美玉出產於崑崙山岡。
main.en: Gold comes from the Li River and jade from Mount Kunlun.
main.simp: 金子出产于丽水，美玉出产于昆仑山冈。

main.zh: 劍中最有名的叫巨闕，珠中最著名的叫夜光。
main.en: The most famous sword is called Juque, the most renowned pearl Yeguang.
main.simp: 剑中最有名的叫巨阙，珠中最著名的叫夜光。

main.zh: 水果以李子和柰子為珍品，蔬菜以芥菜和生薑為重要。
main.en: Among fruits plums and crab-apples are prized; among vegetables mustard greens and ginger are valued.
main.simp: 水果以李子和柰子为珍品，蔬菜以芥菜和生姜为重要。

main.zh: 海水鹹，河水淡，魚類潛游水中，鳥類飛翔空中。
main.en: Sea water is salty and river water fresh; fish dive and birds fly.
main.simp: 海水咸，河水淡，鱼类潜游水中，鸟类飞翔空中。

main.zh: 有以龍為官名的龍師伏羲，有火帝神農，有以鳥為官名的少昊，還有人皇氏。
main.en: There were Fu Xi the Dragon Master, Shennong the Fire Emperor, Shaohao who named his officials after birds, and the Human Sovereign.
main.simp: 有以龙为官名的龙师伏羲，有火帝神农，有以鸟为官名的少昊，还有人皇氏。

main.zh: 開始創製文字，於是穿上衣裳。
main.en: Writing was first devised, and then clothes were worn.
main.simp: 开始创制文字，于是穿上衣裳。

main.zh: 讓出帝位，把國家禪讓給賢人，那是有虞氏舜和陶唐氏堯。
main.en: Giving up the throne and yielding the realm to the worthy were Shun of Youyu and Yao of Taotang.
main.simp: 让出帝位，把国家禅让给贤人，那是有虞氏舜和陶唐氏尧。

main.zh: 撫慰百姓、討伐暴君，是周武王姬發和商湯。
main.en: Comforting the people and punishing tyrants were King Wu of Zhou, Ji Fa, and Tang of Shang.
main.simp: 抚慰百姓、讨伐暴君，是周武王姬发和商汤。

main.zh: 坐在朝堂上詢問治國之道，垂衣拱手，天下便得到治理。
main.en: They sat in court asking about the Way, and with robes hanging and hands folded the realm was governed.
main.simp: 坐在朝堂上询问治国之道，垂衣拱手，天下便得到治理。

main.zh: 愛護養育百姓，連戎、羌等外族也臣服了。
main.en: They cherished and nurtured the common people, and even the Rong and Qiang peoples submitted.
main.simp: 爱护养育百姓，连戎、羌等外族也臣服了。

main.zh: 遠方和近處合為一體，都帶領賓服歸順天子。
main.en: Far and near became one body, and all led one another to the king as his guests.
main.simp: 远方和近处合为一体，都带领宾服归顺天子。

main.zh: 鳳凰在樹上鳴叫，白色的駿馬在場圃吃草。
main.en: The phoenix cries in the trees and white colts graze in the field.
main.simp: 凤凰在树上鸣叫，白色的骏马在场圃吃草。

main.zh: 教化遍及草木，恩澤惠及萬方。
main.en: His teaching reaches even plants and trees and his blessing extends to every region.
main.simp: 教化遍及草木，恩泽惠及万方。

main.zh: 人的身體與毛髮，由四大和五常構成。
main.en: This body and its hair are made of the four elements and the five constants.
main.simp: 人的身体与毛发，由四大和五常构成。

main.zh: 恭敬地想想父母養育之恩，怎麼敢毀壞傷害自己呢？
main.en: Reflect with reverence on the care of your parents who raised you: how dare you damage or harm it?
main.simp: 恭敬地想想父母养育之恩，怎么敢毁坏伤害自己呢？

main.zh: 女子要仰慕貞潔，男子要效法有才德的人。
main.en: Women should admire chastity and purity; men should emulate the talented and good.
main.simp: 女子要仰慕贞洁，男子要效法有才德的人。

main.zh: 知道過錯一定要改正，獲得的才能不要荒廢遺忘。
main.en: Having recognised a fault you must correct it; having gained a skill, do not forget it.
main.simp: 知道过错一定要改正，获得的才能不要荒废遗忘。

main.zh: 不要談論別人的短處，不要倚仗自己的長處。
main.en: Do not speak of others' faults and do not rely on your own strengths.
main.simp: 不要谈论别人的短处，不要倚仗自己的长处。

main.zh: 說出的話要能夠兌現，器量要大到難以測量。
main.en: Let your word be one that can be borne out, and let your capacity be too great to measure.
main.simp: 说出的话要能够兑现，器量要大到难以测量。

main.zh: 墨子見白絲被染而悲嘆，《詩經》讚美《羔羊》。
main.en: Mozi grieved at seeing white silk dyed, and the Book of Songs praised the "Lamb Skins".
main.simp: 墨子见白丝被染而悲叹，《诗经》赞美《羔羊》。

main.zh: 崇高的行為，只有賢人能做到；能克制私念、專心思索，就能成為聖人。
main.en: Lofty conduct is that of the worthy; one who can master his thoughts and reflect can become a sage.
main.simp: 崇高的行为，只有贤人能做到；能克制私念、专心思索，就能成为圣人。

main.zh: 德行建立，名聲自然確立；形體端正，儀表自然端正。
main.en: When virtue is built, a good name is established; when the body is upright, the appearance is correct.
main.simp: 德行建立，名声自然确立；形体端正，仪表自然端正。

main.zh: 空曠的山谷能傳播聲音，空空的廳堂能傳來回響。
main.en: An empty valley carries sound and an empty hall repeats what is heard.
main.simp: 空旷的山谷能传播声音，空空的厅堂能传来回响。

main.zh: 災禍是因為惡行積累而來，福氣是因為善行積累而得。
main.en: Misfortune comes from accumulated evil and blessing from accumulated good.
main.simp: 灾祸是因为恶行积累而来，福气是因为善行积累而得。

main.zh: 一尺長的美玉不算寶貝，一寸短的光陰才值得爭取。
main.en: A foot-long jade disc is no treasure; one inch of time is what is worth striving for.
main.simp: 一尺长的美玉不算宝贝，一寸短的光阴才值得争取。

main.zh: 憑著侍奉父親的心來侍奉君主，要有嚴肅和恭敬。
main.en: Serve your lord with the heart in which you serve your father, with gravity and respect.
main.simp: 凭着侍奉父亲的心来侍奉君主，要有严肃和恭敬。

main.zh: 孝順要竭盡全力，忠誠要不惜性命。
main.en: Filial piety calls for all your strength and loyalty for your very life.
main.simp: 孝顺要竭尽全力，忠诚要不惜性命。

main.zh: 像面臨深淵、腳踩薄冰一樣小心，早起為父母溫暖冬天、清涼夏天。
main.en: Be as careful as one on the brink of a depth or on thin ice; rise early to keep parents warm in winter and cool in summer.
main.simp: 像面临深渊、脚踩薄冰一样小心，早起为父母温暖冬天、清凉夏天。

main.zh: 像蘭花一樣芬芳，像松樹一樣茂盛。
main.en: Be fragrant like the orchid and flourishing like the pine.
main.simp: 像兰花一样芬芳，像松树一样茂盛。

main.zh: 像河水一樣流動不停，像深潭一樣澄清，能映照萬物。
main.en: Be like a river that flows without rest and a pool so clear that it gives back reflections.
main.simp: 像河水一样流动不停，像深潭一样澄清，能映照万物。

main.zh: 儀容舉止要像在思考，言語措辭要安詳穩定。
main.en: Let your bearing be thoughtful and your speech calm and steady.
main.simp: 仪容举止要像在思考，言语措辞要安详稳定。

main.zh: 開始時誠懇踏實固然很好，結尾時謹慎周到更為相宜。
main.en: A sincere beginning is truly good, and a careful ending is even more fitting.
main.simp: 开始时诚恳踏实固然很好，结尾时谨慎周到更为相宜。

main.zh: 這是榮耀事業的基礎，名聲因此盛大無窮。
main.en: This is the foundation of honourable achievement, and renown follows without end.
main.simp: 这是荣耀事业的基础，名声因此盛大无穷。

main.zh: 學業優秀就可以出來做官，擔任職務參與政事。
main.en: Excellent in study, one may take office, hold a post and take part in government.
main.simp: 学业优秀就可以出来做官，担任职务参与政事。

main.zh: 召公在世時在甘棠樹下聽政，他離去後人們越發歌頌他。
main.en: While Duke Shao lived he judged cases beneath the sweet pear tree, and after he left people praised him all the more.
main.simp: 召公在世时在甘棠树下听政，他离去后人们越发歌颂他。

main.zh: 音樂因貴賤而不同，禮儀區分尊貴與卑賤。
main.en: Music differs for high and low, and rites distinguish the honoured from the humble.
main.simp: 音乐因贵贱而不同，礼仪区分尊贵与卑贱。

main.zh: 上下和睦相處，丈夫倡導，妻子隨從。
main.en: Superiors and inferiors live in harmony; the husband leads and the wife follows.
main.simp: 上下和睦相处，丈夫倡导，妻子随从。

main.zh: 在外接受師傅的教導，在家奉行母親的儀範。
main.en: Outside, accept the teaching of your tutors; at home, follow your mother's example.
main.simp: 在外接受师傅的教导，在家奉行母亲的仪范。

main.zh: 對各位姑母、伯父、叔父，要像對父母一樣尊敬；對兄弟的孩子，要像對自己的孩子一樣愛護。
main.en: Honour your aunts and uncles as you would your parents, and care for your brothers' children as for your own.
main.simp: 对各位姑母、伯父、叔父，要像对父母一样尊敬；对兄弟的孩子，要像对自己的孩子一样爱护。

main.zh: 兄弟之間彼此非常關懷，因為同氣所生，像樹枝連著一棵樹。
main.en: Brothers care for one another deeply, being of the same breath, like branches joined to one tree.
main.simp: 兄弟之间彼此非常关怀，因为同气所生，像树枝连着一棵树。

main.zh: 結交朋友要志趣投合，彼此切磋琢磨、規勸告誡。
main.en: In making friends, share your inclinations, and polish and admonish one another.
main.simp: 结交朋友要志趣投合，彼此切磋琢磨、规劝告诫。

main.zh: 仁愛慈悲、惻隱之心，在倉促之間也不可離開。
main.en: Humaneness, kindness and compassion must not leave you even in a moment of haste.
main.simp: 仁爱慈悲、恻隐之心，在仓促之间也不可离开。

main.zh: 節操、正義、廉潔、謙讓，即使在顛沛流離時也不可虧損。
main.en: Integrity, righteousness, honesty and modesty must not be impaired even in times of hardship.
main.simp: 节操、正义、廉洁、谦让，即使在颠沛流离时也不可亏损。

main.zh: 天性安靜，心情就安逸；心思一動，精神就疲憊。
main.en: When one's nature is still, the feelings are at ease; when the mind stirs, the spirit tires.
main.simp: 天性安静，心情就安逸；心思一动，精神就疲惫。

main.zh: 堅守本真，志向就圓滿；追逐外物，心意就會轉移。
main.en: Keep to what is true and the will is fulfilled; chase after things and the intent drifts.
main.simp: 坚守本真，志向就圆满；追逐外物，心意就会转移。

main.zh: 堅持高雅的操守，高官厚祿自然會歸向你。
main.en: Hold to refined principles, and high office will come to you of itself.
main.simp: 坚持高雅的操守，高官厚禄自然会归向你。

main.zh: 都城在華夏之地，有東西兩座京城。
main.en: The capitals lie in the Chinese heartland: the two cities of east and west.
main.simp: 都城在华夏之地，有东西两座京城。

main.zh: 背靠北邙山，面對洛水，浮著渭水，依據涇水。
main.en: Mount Mang at its back and the Luo before it, floating on the Wei and resting on the Jing.
main.simp: 背靠北邙山，面对洛水，浮着渭水，依据泾水。

main.zh: 宮殿盤曲重疊，樓閣高聳，令人驚歎。
main.en: Palaces coil and pile up, and towers and pavilions soar, startling the eye.
main.simp: 宫殿盘曲重叠，楼阁高耸，令人惊叹。

main.zh: 牆上畫著飛禽走獸，彩繪著神仙靈怪。
main.en: Birds and beasts are drawn on the walls, and immortals and spirits painted in colour.
main.simp: 墙上画着飞禽走兽，彩绘着神仙灵怪。

main.zh: 丙舍在旁邊開著門，甲帳對著殿柱。
main.en: The side halls open at the flank and the grand tents face the pillars.
main.simp: 丙舍在旁边开着门，甲帐对着殿柱。

main.zh: 擺開宴席，設置座位，彈瑟吹笙。
main.en: Banquets are laid and mats spread, with zithers played and reed-organs blown.
main.simp: 摆开宴席，设置座位，弹瑟吹笙。

main.zh: 登上臺階走向殿陛，官員的帽子晃動，像星星閃耀。
main.en: Ascending the steps to the throne-hall, the officials' caps flicker like stars.
main.simp: 登上台阶走向殿陛，官员的帽子晃动，像星星闪耀。

main.zh: 右邊通向廣內殿，左邊達到承明殿。
main.en: To the right it leads to the Guangnei hall and to the left to the Chengming hall.
main.simp: 右边通向广内殿，左边达到承明殿。

main.zh: 既收集了古代典籍，又聚集了眾多英才。
main.en: It has gathered the ancient classics and collected many outstanding men.
main.simp: 既收集了古代典籍，又聚集了众多英才。

main.zh: 有杜度的草書稿、鍾繇的隸書，有漆寫的竹簡和牆壁中發現的經書。
main.en: There are Du Du's cursive drafts and Zhong You's clerical script, books lacquer-written on bamboo and classics found in a wall.
main.simp: 有杜度的草书稿、钟繇的隶书，有漆写的竹简和墙壁中发现的经书。

main.zh: 官府中羅列將軍和宰相，道路兩旁是三公九卿。
main.en: The offices are lined with generals and chancellors, and the roads are flanked by the highest ministers.
main.simp: 官府中罗列将军和宰相，道路两旁是三公九卿。

main.zh: 封給八個縣的民戶，家中配有上千的兵士。
main.en: Households of eight counties are granted as fiefs, and a thousand soldiers are assigned to each house.
main.simp: 封给八个县的民户，家中配有上千的兵士。

main.zh: 戴著高冠，隨侍在皇帝車駕旁，車輪疾馳，冠纓搖動。
main.en: In tall caps they attend the imperial carriage, wheels racing and cap strings swinging.
main.simp: 戴着高冠，随侍在皇帝车驾旁，车轮疾驰，冠缨摇动。

main.zh: 世代享受俸祿，奢侈富貴，乘著輕便的車、騎著肥壯的馬。
main.en: Generation after generation they enjoy stipends, rich and extravagant, riding in light carriages and on fat horses.
main.simp: 世代享受俸禄，奢侈富贵，乘着轻便的车、骑着肥壮的马。

main.zh: 記錄功勞，選取其中有實績的，刻在石碑上，銘文傳世。
main.en: Merits are recorded, the substantial ones chosen, and carved on stelae with inscriptions.
main.simp: 记录功劳，选取其中有实绩的，刻在石碑上，铭文传世。

main.zh: 磻溪垂釣的呂尚和伊尹，都是輔佐當世君王的賢臣，伊尹還擔任過阿衡。
main.en: Lu Shang of Pan Stream and Yi Yin both helped the rulers of their age, and Yi Yin held the office of Aheng.
main.simp: 磻溪垂钓的吕尚和伊尹，都是辅佐当世君王的贤臣，伊尹还担任过阿衡。

main.zh: 周公旦被封在曲阜，若不是周公，誰能經營？
main.en: Dan, Duke of Zhou, was given Qufu; but for the Duke of Zhou, who could have built it?
main.simp: 周公旦被封在曲阜，若不是周公，谁能经营？

main.zh: 齊桓公匡正諸侯、聚合天下，救濟弱小、扶助傾危。
main.en: Duke Huan of Qi set the lords right and brought them together, helping the weak and propping up what was falling.
main.simp: 齐桓公匡正诸侯、聚合天下，救济弱小、扶助倾危。

main.zh: 綺里季等人使漢惠帝回心轉意，傅說感動了殷高宗武丁。
main.en: Qi Liji and others made Emperor Hui of Han change his mind, and Fu Yue touched King Wuding of Yin.
main.simp: 绮里季等人使汉惠帝回心转意，傅说感动了殷高宗武丁。

main.zh: 英才們勤勉盡心，眾多賢士使國家安寧。
main.en: Talented men laboured with diligence, and many worthies brought peace to the state.
main.simp: 英才们勤勉尽心，众多贤士使国家安宁。

main.zh: 晉國和楚國先後稱霸，趙國和魏國被連橫之策所困。
main.en: Jin and Chu in turn became hegemon, and Zhao and Wei were hemmed in by the horizontal alliance.
main.simp: 晋国和楚国先后称霸，赵国和魏国被连横之策所困。

main.zh: 借路消滅虢國，在踐土會盟諸侯。
main.en: Jin borrowed passage to destroy Guo, and the lords met in covenant at Jiantu.
main.simp: 借路消灭虢国，在践土会盟诸侯。

main.zh: 蕭何遵循簡約的法令，韓非敗在繁苛的刑罰。
main.en: Xiao He followed the simple laws, and Han Fei was ruined by harsh and complicated punishments.
main.simp: 萧何遵循简约的法令，韩非败在繁苛的刑罚。

main.zh: 白起、王翦、廉頗、李牧，用兵最為精妙。
main.en: Bai Qi, Wang Jian, Lian Po and Li Mu used armies most skilfully.
main.simp: 白起、王翦、廉颇、李牧，用兵最为精妙。

main.zh: 他們在沙漠揚威，名聲在畫像中流傳。
main.en: They spread their might over the deserts, and their fame was carried in painted portraits.
main.simp: 他们在沙漠扬威，名声在画像中流传。

main.zh: 九州都有大禹的足跡，百個郡縣被秦朝吞併。
main.en: The nine provinces bear Yu's footprints, and the hundred commanderies were united by Qin.
main.simp: 九州都有大禹的足迹，百个郡县被秦朝吞并。

main.zh: 五嶽以恆山、泰山為尊，封禪以云云山、亭亭山為主。
main.en: Of the Five Peaks, Mount Heng and Mount Tai are honoured, and the sacrifices of feng and shan were held at Yunyun and Tingting.
main.simp: 五岳以恒山、泰山为尊，封禅以云云山、亭亭山为主。

main.zh: 雁門關、紫塞長城，雞田驛、赤城山。
main.en: Yanmen Pass and the Purple Frontier, Jitian post and Mount Chicheng,
main.simp: 雁门关、紫塞长城，鸡田驿、赤城山。

main.zh: 昆明池、碣石山，鉅野澤、洞庭湖。
main.en: Lake Kunming and Mount Jieshi, the Great Marsh and Lake Dongting --
main.simp: 昆明池、碣石山，巨野泽、洞庭湖。

main.zh: 地域遼闊遙遠，山巖洞穴幽深昏暗。
main.en: the land is vast and remote, and its cliffs and caves deep and dim.
main.simp: 地域辽阔遥远，山岩洞穴幽深昏暗。

main.zh: 治國以農業為根本，要致力於耕種收穫。
main.en: Government takes agriculture as its root, so devote yourself to sowing and reaping.
main.simp: 治国以农业为根本，要致力于耕种收获。

main.zh: 開始到南邊的田畝去工作，我種植黍和稷。
main.en: Work begins in the southern fields, where I sow broomcorn millet and millet.
main.simp: 开始到南边的田亩去工作，我种植黍和稷。

main.zh: 莊稼成熟後繳納賦稅，進獻新穀，獎賞勤勞者，罷黜懶惰者。
main.en: When the crops ripen, taxes are paid and new grain offered; the diligent are rewarded and the idle dismissed.
main.simp: 庄稼成熟后缴纳赋税，进献新谷，奖赏勤劳者，罢黜懒惰者。

main.zh: 孟軻為人質樸敦厚，史魚秉性剛直。
main.en: Mencius was honest and sincere, and Shi Yu kept to uprightness.
main.simp: 孟轲为人质朴敦厚，史鱼秉性刚直。

main.zh: 差不多近於中庸之道，勤勞謙遜、謹慎自勉。
main.en: To come close to the Mean is to be diligent, modest, careful and self-disciplined.
main.simp: 差不多近于中庸之道，勤劳谦逊、谨慎自勉。

main.zh: 聽聲音能辨明道理，看容貌能分辨神色。
main.en: Listen to a voice and discern the principle, look at a face and read the expression.
main.simp: 听声音能辨明道理，看容貌能分辨神色。

main.zh: 留給後代好的謀略，勉勵他們恭敬地樹立根基。
main.en: Leave good counsel to later generations and urge them to build their foundations with reverence.
main.simp: 留给后代好的谋略，勉励他们恭敬地树立根基。

main.zh: 反省自身，對譏諷告誡保持警覺；受寵愈多，愈要防備走到極端。
main.en: Examine yourself, take warning against mockery and admonition; the more favour you receive, the more you must guard against extremes.
main.simp: 反省自身，对讥讽告诫保持警觉；受宠愈多，愈要防备走到极端。

main.zh: 危險和恥辱近在眼前，到山林水澤中隱居便是幸事。
main.en: When danger and disgrace are near, it is fortunate to retire to hills and marshes.
main.simp: 危险和耻辱近在眼前，到山林水泽中隐居便是幸事。

main.zh: 疏廣、疏受兩人看清了時機，解下官印，誰逼迫他們了？
main.en: The two Shus saw the moment and unfastened their seals; who forced them?
main.simp: 疏广、疏受两人看清了时机，解下官印，谁逼迫他们了？

main.zh: 獨自居住，清閒安處，沉默寂寥。
main.en: Living alone in quiet leisure, silent and still,
main.simp: 独自居住，清闲安处，沉默寂寥。

main.zh: 探求古人的學說，尋找議論，排遣憂慮，自在逍遙。
main.en: they search for the teachings of the ancients and look for discussion, scatter their cares and wander free.
main.simp: 探求古人的学说，寻找议论，排遣忧虑，自在逍遥。

main.zh: 欣喜之事來了，煩累就被遣去；憂愁離去，歡樂就來臨。
main.en: Joy comes and burdens are sent away; sorrows depart and delight arrives.
main.simp: 欣喜之事来了，烦累就被遣去；忧愁离去，欢乐就来临。

main.zh: 渠中的荷花鮮明艷麗，園裡的野草抽出新枝條。
main.en: Lotuses in the channels are bright and clear, and weeds in the garden put out shoots.
main.simp: 渠中的荷花鲜明艳丽，园里的野草抽出新枝条。

main.zh: 枇杷到晚冬仍然翠綠，梧桐早早就凋落。
main.en: The loquat is still green late in the year, and the wutong sheds its leaves early.
main.simp: 枇杷到晚冬仍然翠绿，梧桐早早就凋落。

main.zh: 老樹根枯萎，被遮蔽覆蓋；落葉在風中飄搖。
main.en: Old roots wither and are covered over, and fallen leaves drift in the wind.
main.simp: 老树根枯萎，被遮蔽覆盖；落叶在风中飘摇。

main.zh: 遊動的鵾雞獨自翱翔，凌空而上，摩擦赤色的雲霄。
main.en: The roaming kun bird glides alone, rising to brush the crimson sky.
main.simp: 游动的鹍鸡独自翱翔，凌空而上，摩擦赤色的云霄。

main.zh: 沉迷閱讀，在市集的書攤上流連，把目光寄託在書囊書箱之間。
main.en: Absorbed in reading, I linger at the book stalls of the market, resting my eyes on bags and boxes of books.
main.simp: 沉迷阅读，在市集的书摊上流连，把目光寄托在书囊书箱之间。

main.zh: 把輕易說話看作可畏，要知道隔牆有耳。
main.en: Take careless speech as something to fear, for walls have ears.
main.simp: 把轻易说话看作可畏，要知道隔墙有耳。

main.zh: 準備好飯食，只要合口味、能填飽肚子就好。
main.en: Prepare meals with dishes that suit the taste and fill the stomach.
main.simp: 准备好饭食，只要合口味、能填饱肚子就好。

main.zh: 吃飽時連烹宰的美味都嫌多，飢餓時糟糠也不嫌棄。
main.en: When full, one is sated even with dainty fare; when hungry, one does not despise dregs and husks.
main.simp: 吃饱时连烹宰的美味都嫌多，饥饿时糟糠也不嫌弃。

main.zh: 招待親戚故友，老人和小孩的飯食不同。
main.en: For relatives and old friends, the old and the young are fed differently.
main.simp: 招待亲戚故友，老人和小孩的饭食不同。

main.zh: 侍妾和女僕紡紗織布，在內室服侍盥洗。
main.en: Concubines and maids spin and weave, and serve with towels in the inner chambers.
main.simp: 侍妾和女仆纺纱织布，在内室服侍盥洗。

main.zh: 白絹團扇圓潔，銀燭明亮輝煌。
main.en: Round silk fans are clean and white and silver candles blaze bright.
main.simp: 白绢团扇圆洁，银烛明亮辉煌。

main.zh: 白天午睡，夜晚安寢，有藍色的竹席、象牙的床。
main.en: They nap by day and sleep by night on blue bamboo mats and ivory beds.
main.simp: 白天午睡，夜晚安寝，有蓝色的竹席、象牙的床。

main.zh: 彈琴歌唱，飲酒宴會，舉杯相敬。
main.en: With strings, songs and wine at the feast, they raise and exchange cups.
main.simp: 弹琴歌唱，饮酒宴会，举杯相敬。

main.zh: 手舞足蹈，歡樂愉快又安康。
main.en: Hands dance and feet stamp, glad and healthy.
main.simp: 手舞足蹈，欢乐愉快又安康。

main.zh: 嫡長子繼承後嗣，延續祭祀，冬祭稱烝，秋祭稱嘗。
main.en: The eldest legitimate son inherits and continues the sacrifices, the winter offering called zheng and the autumn offering called chang.
main.simp: 嫡长子继承后嗣，延续祭祀，冬祭称烝，秋祭称尝。

main.zh: 叩頭至地，再拜行禮，心中誠惶誠恐。
main.en: He touches his forehead to the ground, bows twice, and is reverent and fearful.
main.simp: 叩头至地，再拜行礼，心中诚惶诚恐。

main.zh: 書信文牘要簡明扼要，回答詢問要審慎詳盡。
main.en: Letters and notes should be brief and to the point, and answers to questions careful and thorough.
main.simp: 书信文牍要简明扼要，回答询问要审慎详尽。

main.zh: 身上髒了就想洗澡，手拿熱物就盼望涼爽。
main.en: When the body is dirty one wants a bath, and when holding something hot one longs for coolness.
main.simp: 身上脏了就想洗澡，手拿热物就盼望凉爽。

main.zh: 驢、騾、牛犢和公牛，受驚時奔跳超越。
main.en: Donkeys, mules, calves and bulls bound and leap far when startled.
main.simp: 驴、骡、牛犊和公牛，受惊时奔跳超越。

main.zh: 誅殺盜賊，捕獲叛逆逃亡的人。
main.en: Kill robbers and thieves and capture rebels and deserters.
main.simp: 诛杀盗贼，捕获叛逆逃亡的人。

main.zh: 呂布善射，熊宜僚善玩彈丸，嵇康善彈琴，阮籍善長嘯。
main.en: Lu Bu was a fine archer, Xiong Yiliao deft with pellets, Ji Kang played the zither and Ruan Ji whistled.
main.simp: 吕布善射，熊宜僚善玩弹丸，嵇康善弹琴，阮籍善长啸。

main.zh: 蒙恬發明筆，蔡倫發明紙，馬鈞巧於機械，任公子善於釣魚。
main.en: Meng Tian made the brush, Cai Lun paper, Ma Jun was skilled at mechanisms, and Prince Ren at fishing.
main.simp: 蒙恬发明笔，蔡伦发明纸，马钧巧于机械，任公子善于钓鱼。

main.zh: 他們都能排解紛爭，有利於世俗，全都美好奇妙。
main.en: They could resolve disputes and benefit the age; all were fine and wonderful.
main.simp: 他们都能排解纷争，有利于世俗，全都美好奇妙。

main.zh: 毛嬙和西施姿容美好，皺眉頭也巧妙，微笑也美麗。
main.en: Mao Qiang and Xi Shi were lovely, whose frowns were skilful and whose smiles were beautiful.
main.simp: 毛嫱和西施姿容美好，皱眉头也巧妙，微笑也美丽。

main.zh: 歲月如箭，每每催人老去，日月的光輝明亮照耀。
main.en: The years fly like arrows, always urging us on, while the light of the sun shines bright.
main.simp: 岁月如箭，每每催人老去，日月的光辉明亮照耀。

main.zh: 北斗星的璇璣懸空運轉，月亮盈虧循環照耀。
main.en: The jewelled turning-pivot of the Dipper hangs and rotates, and the moon waxes and wanes, shining in its round.
main.simp: 北斗星的璇玑悬空运转，月亮盈亏循环照耀。

main.zh: 像薪柴傳火那樣修養福德，永遠安穩，吉祥而勉力。
main.en: Cultivate blessings as fire passes from one faggot to the next, and be forever at ease, fortunate and diligent.
main.simp: 像薪柴传火那样修养福德，永远安稳，吉祥而勉力。

main.zh: 邁著方正的步子，昂首挺胸，在廊廟之中舉止俯仰得體。
main.en: Walk with measured steps and lifted head, and carry yourself properly in the halls of court.
main.simp: 迈着方正的步子，昂首挺胸，在廊庙之中举止俯仰得体。

main.zh: 束好衣帶，端莊嚴肅，徘徊四顧而遠望。
main.en: Gird up your robe, grave and dignified, pacing and looking around.
main.simp: 束好衣带，端庄严肃，徘徊四顾而远望。

main.zh: 見識淺陋，聞見貧乏，愚昧蒙昧，只會被人譏笑。
main.en: Ignorant and with little knowledge, foolish and dull, one only draws ridicule.
main.simp: 见识浅陋，闻见贫乏，愚昧蒙昧，只会被人讥笑。

main.zh: 所謂語助詞，就是焉、哉、乎、也。
main.en: What are called particles of speech are yan, zai, hu and ye.
main.simp: 所谓语助词，就是焉、哉、乎、也。
